definitions.explanation: A company that owns a controlling interest in one or more subsidiary companies. The metaphor of 'parent' (親) mirrors the English term.

examples.japanese: {親会社|おやがいしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧。
examples.english: To follow the parent company's policy.

examples.japanese: {親会社|おやがいしゃ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調達|ちょうたつ}→調達：09938_choutatsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We procured funds from the parent company.

examples.japanese: {親会社|おやがいしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{業績|ぎょうせき}→業績：04873_gyouseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪化|あっか}する→悪化する：18844_akkasuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{子会社|こがいしゃ}→子会社：12258_kogaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: When the parent company's performance worsens, the subsidiaries are affected too.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧ (parent) and ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧ (company). A standard business term referring to a company that controls one or more other companies through ownership of shares.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {親会社|おやがいしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧ — parent company's policy
- {親会社|おやがいしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧ — instructions from the parent company
- {親会社|おやがいしゃ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{子会社|こがいしゃ}→子会社：12258_kogaisha⟧ — parent and subsidiary companies

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{子会社|こがいしゃ}→子会社：12258_kogaisha⟧ — subsidiary company
- ⟦{関連会社|かんれんがいしゃ}→関連会社：19758_kanrengaisha⟧ — affiliated company; associated company
- {持株会社|もちかぶがいしゃ} — holding company
- {グループ会社|ぐるーぷがいしゃ} — group company
